notes: Cats: the subject is Certified only, so intro is empty (the Régionale Spain category holds four stems on these DOs among 59, too loose a door, and they are counted in the review); Spain in the Village bank carries the Txakoli and Vino de Pago stems. Chapters: no Régionale chapter covers these DOs; the Village Spain chapter has the ladder with Vino de Pago (fact 1) and Monastrell in Jumilla (fact 9), and nothing on the Basque Country. Regions: jumilla-yecla for Murcia, la-mancha because the Court places the Vinos de Pago in Castilla-La Mancha and that article holds Dominio de Valdepusa and the regional list. The Basque Country has no article in REGIONS yet: the roster plans txakoli (Txakoli and the Basque Country) as an article off the map, and it should become this subject's third region door once it ships; navarra, which holds three pagos, is left out as a looser door. Country: spain for the ladder and its Vino de Pago rung. Grapes: Monastrell, the one Court grape the Codex profiles (Hondarrabi Zuri and Beltza have no grape record). Techniques: phylloxera-rootstocks for the ungrafted Monastrell on sand that the Court puts in Murcia's grape growing and history cells. No service table: the Court's page has no service cell.
